SELECT
    t.id,
    t.nome_abreviado AS nome,
    COALESCE(t.disponibilidade_informada_percentual, 0) AS disponibilidade,
    dc.descricao AS cargo,
    ds.descricao AS senioridade,
    COALESCE(
      json_agg(DISTINCT s.nome_skill) FILTER (WHERE s.nome_skill IS NOT NULL),
      '[]'::json
    ) AS skills
FROM "InHire".talentos t
LEFT JOIN "InHire".dominios dc ON dc.id = t.id_cargo AND dc.tipo_dominio = 'CARGO'
LEFT JOIN "InHire".dominios ds ON ds.id = t.id_senioridade AND ds.tipo_dominio = 'SENIORIDADE'
LEFT JOIN "InHire".talento_skills ts ON ts.id_talento = t.id
LEFT JOIN "InHire".skills s ON s.id = ts.id_skill AND s.status IS TRUE AND s.deletado IS FALSE
WHERE t.status IS TRUE
GROUP BY t.id, t.nome_abreviado, t.disponibilidade_informada_percentual, dc.descricao, ds.descricao
ORDER BY disponibilidade DESC, nome;

SELECT
    d.id,
    d.nome_demanda AS nome,
    (SELECT dom.descricao FROM "InHire".dominios dom WHERE dom.id = d.id_andamento_demanda LIMIT 1) AS andamento,
    d.dt_inicio_demanda AS inicio,
    d.dt_termino_demanda_prevista AS termino,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS pessoas,
    COALESCE(
      json_agg(DISTINCT jsonb_build_object('id', c.id, 'id_colaborador', c.id, 'nome', c.nome_abreviado, 'cargo', cargo.descricao, 'senioridade', senioridade.descricao, 'origem', 'Interno (SGD)', 'alocacao_atual', (SELECT CASE WHEN SUM(px.porcentagem) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CONCAT(SUM(px.porcentagem), '%') END FROM "InHire".alocacoes alx JOIN "InHire".planejamentos px ON px.id_alocacao=alx.id WHERE alx.id_colaborador=c.id AND alx.status IS TRUE AND alx.deletado IS FALSE AND px.status IS TRUE AND px.deletado IS FALSE), 'skills', (SELECT json_agg(sk.nome_skill) FROM "InHire".colaborador_skills cs JOIN "InHire".skills sk ON sk.id=cs.id_skill WHERE cs.id_colaborador=c.id)))
      FILTER (WHERE c.id IS NOT NULL),
      '[]'::json
    ) AS colaboradores
FROM "InHire".demandas d
LEFT JOIN "InHire".dominios andamento ON andamento.id = d.id_andamento_demanda AND andamento.status IS TRUE AND andamento.deletado IS FALSE
LEFT JOIN "InHire".alocacoes a
  ON a.id_demanda = d.id AND a.status IS TRUE AND a.deletado IS FALSE
LEFT JOIN "InHire".colaboradores c ON c.id = a.id_colaborador AND c.status IS TRUE AND c.deletado IS FALSE
LEFT JOIN "InHire".dominios cargo ON cargo.id=c.id_cargo
LEFT JOIN "InHire".dominios senioridade ON senioridade.id=c.id_senioridade
WHERE d.status IS TRUE AND d.deletado IS FALSE
GROUP BY d.id, d.nome_demanda, d.dt_inicio_demanda, d.dt_termino_demanda_prevista
ORDER BY d.id;
